summary: Practise privacy reviews, records searches, and information request handling. Explore the five-day foundation course and its applied exercises.
lede: Responsible information handling connects privacy safeguards with consistent access to organizational records. For privacy, records, and information-access professionals, the training develops practical ways to map personal-data flows, locate responsive records, and assess disclosure risks. Participants also practise logging requests, making redaction decisions, and documenting their rationale, with attention to automated discovery and human review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage personal information, records, privacy reviews, and requests for access to organizational information.
modules: OECD Privacy Guidelines and Access Foundations
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace records and information-handling responsibilities is useful. No programming is required. Bring a laptop only if you prefer to draft digital templates using your existing software; no specific platform is required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
